chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurārah, who said:
I said: The poor person upon whom charity is given—does he have to give Ṣadaqat al-Fiṭrah? He said: Yes, he gives from that which is given in charity to him.

key_terms.الْفَقِيرُ: the poor person; one lacking sufficient means
key_terms.صَدَقَةُ الْفِطْرَةِ: the alms of Fiṭrah given at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.مِمَّا: from that which; indicating the source of what is given
key_terms.يُتَصَدَّقُ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ: that by which charity is given to him; what he receives as charity
key_terms.يُتَصَدَّقُ عَلَيْهِ: charity is given to him; he is a recipient of alms

ai.seo_question: Does a poor person who receives charity still have to pay Ṣadaqat al-Fiṭrah?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of Ṣadaqat al-Fiṭrah regarding a poor person who receives charity. It states that even such a person gives Fiṭrah from what is given to him, indicating the legal scope of this obligation in relation to poverty and receiving charity.
